expected_effect: No action proposed, so no effect is expected. Nothing in the system state should change as a result of this proposal. The useful next step is not a remediation at all: restore the investigation host's DNS resolution for prometheus-server.observe.svc.cluster.local, loki.observe.svc.cluster.local and jaeger-out.observe.svc.cluster.local, or obtain kube events and container restart counts for the four workloads out-of-band, so that a culprit can be named before anything is touched.
if_wrong: This abstention is wrong if someone produces evidence meeting an action's precondition — e.g. kube events or restart counts showing one of the four containers in CrashLoopBackOff or repeatedly restarting since 17:16:04, which would point at process state and justify restart_service on that specific service. It is also wrong if change history outside the 24-hour window shows a prior image tag or prior ConfigMap for one of these services, which would make rollback_image or revert_config eligible. Note separately: with Prometheus, Loki and Jaeger all unreachable from this vantage point [tr_e66eea973aa7, tr_8e06eccc4879, tr_bf905e3b47c4], the effect of ANY remediation taken now could not be observed through metrics, logs or traces — an unverifiable action is a second reason to hold.
risk: The risk of abstaining is that a genuinely broken service stays broken for longer while DNS or event access is repaired; the four services have been failing since first start seven minutes before onset, so no further degradation is accumulating from a previously-working state. The risk of NOT abstaining is larger and concrete: the three plausible actions each fail their preconditions. rollback_image and revert_config have no prior revision or prior config to return to for any of these four services — all recorded events are first creations by platform-automation [tr_0968b4b0cc91, tr_a5b95ee9dcf7, tr_0a7a4390ab64, tr_789300c8ad7c] — so a rollback would amount to deleting a service that may be the only working part of the stack. restart_service requires evidence pointing at process state, and there is none: no trace, metric or log signal implicates or exonerates any of the four [tr_bf905e3b47c4, tr_415f12bc7d74, tr_e81ca40ccc7b]. Restarting a service picked without evidence is a one-in-four guess, is irreversible, discards cache, and would muddy the startup-failure question that kube events still have to answer.
blast_radius: Nobody. No service is touched and no caller sees a change. For contrast, had an action been proposed: a restart or rollback of compose-post-service, home-timeline-service or user-timeline-service would be seen as a connection reset by nginx-web-server, which is the inbound edge to all three and the alerted edge of this incident; an action on nginx-web-server itself would be seen by every external caller of the social-network namespace, since it is the edge.
